reviews.text: We went to get an assessment on our sickly cat. The vet was fantastic and recommended steps to help and suggested affordability avenues. Great.
What a friendly and helpful gang they are at medivet Roehampton whether chatting on the phone or in person. Obviously animal lovers and committed to giving best service.
excellent
We had a very good experience with MediVet .very welcoming place for our kitten. Very helpful and friendly environment
From walking in and Lesley giving Stamford lots of cuddles and treats to Vet Miren’s kind and careful care, I could not have asked for a better experience.
Excellent practice, with great staff and excellent vets. Very dedicated and caring. Go over and beyond what's expected.
Excellent care as always and prompt appointment for my dog. Thank you
I have a kitten and I must say you were very good with her and you all feel in love with our Bobby
Fantastic service. Fantastic receptionist lovely guy understanding and caring. Thank you

I feel very lucky to live within the zone of this lovely veterinary surgery.  I know brands like Medivet tend to get a bad rap, but the team at Medivet Roehampton do a super job.   I find the service friendly and efficient, the charges reasonable and the environment (a pretty little building right on Putney Heath) attractive.  A particular shout-out to the main vet, Miren Singh, who is capable, efficient and friendly.
All the staff were so friendly and kind to my 3 month old kitten. It is a very welcoming practice.

Everyone is always very nice, polite, friendly, understanding and professional. From receptionists to the doctors, everyone always treats me and my cats with kindness. Cats are always well taken care of and doctors and nurses make sure to minimise the stress for them as much as possible.

We cannot thank the team at Medivet Roehampton enough for the exceptional care and compassion they showed our beautiful Havanese.

From the moment they started investigating what was wrong with her, they were thorough, caring and genuinely committed to understanding what was happening. Sadly, despite their efforts, we eventually lost her.

What  meant so much to us was the kindness and compassion they continued to show not only to our Havanese, but to us as a family, throughout her final hours and when we had to say goodbye. They treated her with such gentleness and dignity, and gave us the time and support we needed during an incredibly heartbreaking experience.

Thank you for seeing our Havanese not simply as a patient, but as the precious little dog she was to us. ❤️🐾

We would wholeheartedly recommend Medivet Roehampton to anyone looking for a veterinary team that combines expertise with genuine compassion and humanity.
Very professional and friendly service
The staff are all very friendly and professional  . Dr Mirren is especially kind with my dog as he is very nervous. Definitely recommend
The team at Medivet is amazing. They take very good care of my pets. I strongly recommend them.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Very friendly and highly competent vets
We always get a great service and were seen on time- very important esp if you have a feline furry frend with you. Keep it up!
Great help and support .
Excellent service. Amazing staff.

Super happy with Medivet Roehampton and the out of hours practice at Richmond which we've also used. All the staff are lovely and knowledgeable including the great staff on reception at both practices. We always feel well looked after and in very safe hands. Thanks so much for all your help!

My cat has been registered with Medivet Roehampton for the last 3 years and we recently had to go in for an emergency. I was in absolutely state, so panicked and scared, but when I called I was reassured and was able to get an emergency appointment within 30 min. Lesley and Glenn at reception were so sweet and caring (and helpful in explaining payments/insurance processes). We saw Dr Georgie, who was equally lovely and took such great care of my cat. I am so grateful for the wonderful staff and their kindness!!

A great caring team, had my cats worming and flea treatment done and some medication for his dermatitis.
He loves his little trips there
All the staff at Medivet are so very lovely, they all so kind and helpful,  and absolutely love our loving family member Riley..

I have been with Medivet Roehampton from the very beginning as well as the previous practice on the same site. Recently I took my new rescue cat Mimi in for her vaccinations and health check. I received excellent service from the Vet. It was very reasonably priced too. The reception staff too are great. Very helpful, professional and genuinely nice.  I would not take my pets anywhere else.
We love this practice Bella has been here from the start and now her brother Buddy is joining. It is hard to find a friendly, competent and animal loving vet and this is it!!❤️
Medivet Roehampton are awesome always nice and i trust them with my four legged sidekick, and that is the best review i can give

Dr Miren is extremely thorough and is really good with my nervous dog. The whole team at Roehampton are amazing.
They are head and shoulders above any other vet in the local area.
Can't recommend Dr Miren enough!
STAFF ARE GOOD. ALWAYS HAVE A PROFESSIONAL SERVICE. THEY ARE REALLY GOOD WITH MY CATS EVEN THOUGH THE CATS ARE SHIT SCARED OF THE VETS. WOULD 110% RECOMMEND THIS VETS PRACTICE

The very kindest and empathetic people you could wish to meet ~ and they all work at Medivet Roehampton.Our little Danny was so poorly,the care that they gave her was exceptional,they really are the best.
Doctor Daniel is amazing so sweet
Beautiful practice,  beautiful staff and always there to help.

We are very happy with the treatment our cats receive.  Medivet Roehampton doesn't feel like a "chain". The team is wonderful from reception staff through to nurses and vets.  We feel known and welcome and everyone cares about the pets.
They made me and my family feel very welcome and also at ease

I continue to have great experiences with Medivet Roehampton.  I feel like everyone cares for the wellbeing of my dog.  Staff comforted him when he was nervous in the waiting room, and the vet was thoughtful and caring in how he handled my pet during the appointment. I have never had an experience where I felt that the vet has recommended something that is unnecessary. I have always been given clear explanations in a patient, friendly manner. Thank you to the team!
Both reception and veterinary team are great!

Excellent practice
Staff are A1
You and your pet feel welcomed as soon as you walk through the door
♥️
Nice staff and doctors

We are first time cat owners and have just adopted our first rescue cat. We had our first appointment this week and the staff were so friendly, kind and made us feel so welcome. Both Lesley and Glenn were so helpful and kind. The vet we saw was very attentive and was happy to answer any questions.

All of the staff here are friendly and helpful. They are always delighted to see my dog and make a fuss of her when she asks for it. They listen to the issue that I describe and care for my dogs wellbeing.

First appointment, booked in emergency. Not only I got an appointment on the day, but everyone at the practice was friendly and understanding.
My dog who is usually big on showing that no-one should be trusted in a vet practice looked comfortable enough.
The treatment was adapted to the dog and... to the owner (a first!).
I highly recommend Medivet Roehampton.
Lovely caring staff...pretty location and money saving treatment..I thoroughly recommend this practice
I am always happy with Medivet Roehampton only my cat doesn't like Vet clinic and stuff trying the best approach to my cat

The best veterinary clinic I’ve ever been to in London. The staff are very welcoming and kind. We’ve been seeing Dr. Miren for over two years now, and she is absolutely amazing. She is incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely caring. Highly recommended!
Excellent service helpful friendly staff

I am very pleased with the team — everyone has been friendly, helpful, and highly professional. My only regret is that I cannot request a specific vet for follow-up appointments.

During my recent visit, the vet who examined my kitten was excellent, and I felt very confident with their care. Since I have already booked my kitten’s next vaccination in four weeks’ time, I was hoping to see the same vet again for continuity, but I was told this is not possible.

I would very much appreciate it if, in future, clients could have the option to book the same vet for follow-up treatments when continuity of care is important.
Bit expensive but got same day appt and staff is also very friendly.

I am so sad to be relocating countries and leaving this wonderful practice! They have been nothing but the best to my cockapoo - Blue!!! They are always so lovely, helpful, professional and reassuring! If we return to the area, I will 100% be returning. I also found the pet plan amazing!
Excellent, kind veterinarians.

I recently visited Medivet Roehampton with my cat for our very first vet appointment, and I couldn’t be more impressed with the care and professionalism we received. As a first-time pet owner, I was a bit nervous and unsure about what to expect, but the whole team immediately put both me and my cat at ease.

From the moment we walked in, the staff were incredibly kind, welcoming, and attentive. The receptionists greeted us warmly and made sure all the paperwork was handled smoothly. The vet and nurses took their time to listen carefully to my concerns and explained every step of the check-up in a way that was easy to understand. They treated my cat so gently and patiently that she stayed calm throughout the entire visit which says a lot.

What I really appreciated most was how thorough and compassionate the vet was. They didn’t rush the appointment, answered all my questions in detail, and even gave me useful advice on how to make my cat more comfortable at home. It’s clear that everyone at Medivet Roehampton genuinely cares about animals and their wellbeing.

I’m truly grateful for their help and kindness, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring veterinary clinic. We’ll definitely be returning for all our future visits 🙌
Danielle was very warm and welcoming. She was very thorough and explained what she was doing being very supportive and helpful
The staff are very friendly and helpful and thr customer service is excellent.  Highly recommend medivet Roehampton.

Absolutely brilliant vets would highly recommend.  Dr miren gave me the best vets 2nd opinion after the male receptionist passed my request to her. After listening to her 2nd opinion Dr miren has really helped me even though I live further away I am really contemplating joining this lovely vets Susan xxx
Reliable, professional practice with kind and reliable staff. They are amazing 🤩 …

Took my cat in for a spay and was nervous about it as she is a very shy/anxious cat. The staff were all really lovely and showed great interest in her. The post surgery meeting was really informative and I will be taking her to this vets again in the future.
Outstanding service  clean and  very friendly . Recommended!

As  always, Tilly and I were looked after very well by everyone
at the surgery, a great team.

I recently lost my cat Mitz sadly but  while in their care Medivet Roehampton were caring and considerate to him at all times .  I do think the charges are quite high but I guess they are in line with other providers?  Their lead vet Dr Miran (apologies if I have spelt her name incorrectly) was particularly kind and caring and explained the stages of his condition and left me to choose whether I wanted to get more and more tests to only prolong the inevitable which of course seemed to come quite suddenly.
Thanks to everyone at the practice.  I had been a client of the previous practice on those premises too, so had been coming there all of Mitz's 18 years!
since I registered my puppy with the Roehampton Vet Clinic I have been very happy with the staff's friendliness and knowledge and efficiency.

I had an excellent veterinarian who provided comprehensive care for my cat - from the thorough initial examination to following up on the referral. That level of professional dedication and genuine concern for my cat is wonderful.

When my beloved dachshund displayed alarming behaviour throughout the night, I thought I’d be begging to see a vet come the morning (especially on a Monday). But they got me an immediate appointment to come in and were so understanding. Said dog was an absolute nightmare once there, but again, the vet was empathetic and tried his best to do the examination. So reassuring and helpful.
Gentle and calm which meant that my dog was relaxed . Thank you
I highly recommend this vets practice, as I trust them whole heartedly with my pets, wouldn't go any where else, they are very compassionate with animals. I wouldn't go anywhere else
Very caring and lovely vets, nurses, and receptionists. Through a very difficult time of losing my beloved dog. All the staff have been amazing.
The MediVet Roehampton team is absolutely wonderful. I’ve never seen a dog (my pug, Ted) so happy to go to the vet! Thank you so much xx
Exceptional the Vet Matthew is amazing
Very good care of my cat and nice and kind vets and receptionists

I wish I could give more stars! The team at Roehampton are absolutely fantastic! Cricket, my Yorkie pup, is beyond excited to see everyone each time we go and he always gets lots of cuddles.
The care the team give is second to none and they have made being a first time pet owner so much easier and less stressful.
Miren and Matt have both been brilliant along with Wendy and the rest of the nursing team. Glenn and Lesley are always so helpful and kind.
Great service, as always. Delighted to meet Miren for the first time for an annual check up. She was excellent with our whippets.

The chap at Reception was very friendly & helpful. And the Vet was so lovely & kind to our cat, that he was very chilled out and let her give him his Flue Jab, Flea Oil, and even cut his nails! And he was happy when she cuddled him and was so relaxed he didn’t want to leave and we had trouble getting him back into his box to go home! Hilarious!
We recently rehomed a dog and took her along to Medivet Roehampton for her first health check. We received a warm welcome and everything was explained clearly, step by step. Thank you.
Excellent service and very welcoming
The service was outstanding

The practice as a whole has much improved since after Richard sold the building, up until about a year and a half ago when the practice was awful. Since I've been in touch with Claire, the vet, things have got much better on all fronts. Luckily, Wendy the practice manager, has been there all along which stopped me leaving altogether.
All round care from staff and vets, and background staff too, even though I messed up the floor ..... Tuppence had a good scream all the way there and back
My injured dog was saved with an emergency surgery.

The team at Medivet Roehampton are fantastic, super friendly and incredibly kind. They take time to explain everything in detail, giving complete peace of mind. Highly recommended!

All of the staff here are amazing.
Never had a bad experience all of the years I’ve been coming here

Thanks guys for being A⭐️

Avoid this vet and chain at all costs, no matter how much further you have to travel for a better one. They fraudulently charged me for products I did not want and were not explained to me, and refused to let me return them. If they refute this review, I have email evidence of them admitting this. Awful people, awful practise.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Best vets by far been using them for over 17yrs

We sent our beloved Ragdoll cat there for what was supposed to be a belly fur cut with a minimal trimming fur cut as needed and got back essentially a sphinx cat with pom-poms who "was distressed". We ended up in tears as well...
NO notice, NO asking for our permission beforehand and NOT even a warning afterwards or an explanation. When I called to complain they said that thought it had to be done and it was a judgement call while she was under but surely someone from reception could have called in the meantime.
Now we have a frightened, naked and freezing cat, whilst hoping the fur grows back as normal as possible by feeding her extra supplements and got charged a fortune for something we did not ask for.
Heard Medivet has been worsening but this a new low. Will not go back again and not uploading pictures because they are too distressful.
@Medivet - no need to answer me as there is nothing you can to to make this right. The damage is done.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.

Lovely and very professional service 👏
Thank you so much …

Sadly we didn’t quite realize that the practice previously owned by the long standing, trustworthy Vet had been sold to a ruthless company. The charges now are absolutely obnoxious, unjustified and unethical. There was a clear taking advantage of someone terrified for their pet, that was very sick, potentially life threatening, and thus with no much choice at that moment. But what was charged for a few days of care is nothing short of outrageous. We have then checked with other practices and for the same treatment anyone else would have charged half or less of the amount. It was a very unfortunate series of circumstances, and undoubtedly we will never use Medivet again. Nevertheless the approach remains outrageous. I would very strongly recommend to go elsewhere. And we are exploring avenues to report what we ultimately deem as malpractice. UPDATE 22/09 - I have contacted the practice at the address suggested below in their response, and after a month of course no acknowledgment and no reply. Hence clearly the response below was for ‘show’, not genuine, and once more unprofessional. Which just strengthens the above feedback.

Friendly staff. Helpful. Thank you
